name: InvokeFlow
label: Invoke Flow
description: Invokes a Salesforce flow with input variables or JSON parameters.

fields.name: ApiName
fields.label: API Name
fields.description: The API name of the flow to invoke

fields.name: UseJsonParameters
fields.label: JSON Parameters
fields.description: If enabled, uses JSON payload instead of variables. Variables will be hidden.

fields.name: JsonParameters
fields.label: JSON Parameters
fields.description: JSON payload to pass to the flow. Only visible when 'JSON Parameters' is enabled.

fields.name: Variables
fields.label: Variables
fields.description: Input variables to pass to the flow. Only visible when 'JSON Parameters' is disabled.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response from Salesforce
